cases.source:
# title: Day of the week
# source: https://rosettacode.org/wiki/Day_of_the_week
# category: Rosetta Code
# difficulty: Intro
# summary: Compute weekdays for fixed Gregorian dates with Zeller's congruence.
# tags: popular, dates, math, calendars
# vibe: 0.1.0

def weekday(year: int, month: int, day: int) -> string
  adjusted_year = year
  adjusted_month = month

  if adjusted_month < 3
    adjusted_month = adjusted_month + 12
    adjusted_year = adjusted_year - 1
  end

  century_year = adjusted_year % 100
  zero_based_century = adjusted_year // 100
  code = (
    day +
      ((13 * (adjusted_month + 1)) // 5) +
      century_year +
      (century_year // 4) +
      (zero_based_century // 4) +
      (5 * zero_based_century)
  ) % 7

  weekday_names.fetch(code)
end

def weekday_names -> array<string>
  ["Saturday", "Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday"]
end

def run -> array<{ date: string, weekday: string }>
  [
    { date: "2026-03-08", weekday: weekday(2026, 3, 8) },
    { date: "2024-02-29", weekday: weekday(2024, 2, 29) },
    { date: "2000-01-01", weekday: weekday(2000, 1, 1) }
  ]
end

# title: Word wrap
# source: https://rosettacode.org/wiki/Word_wrap
# category: Rosetta Code
# difficulty: Intro
# summary: Wrap a paragraph with the standard greedy algorithm at two different column widths.
# tags: popular, text-processing, formatting, greedy
# vibe: 0.1.0

def word_wrap(text: string, width: int) -> array<string>
  words = text.split
  lines: array<string> = []
  current = ""
  index = 0

  while index < words.length
    word = words.fetch(index)
    if current == ""
      current = word
    elsif current.length + 1 + word.length <= width
      current = current + " " + word
    else
      lines = lines + [current]
      current = word
    end
    index = index + 1
  end

  if current != ""
    lines = lines + [current]
  end

  lines
end

def sample_text -> string
  "In olden times when wishing still helped one, there lived a king whose " +
    "daughters were all beautiful, but the youngest was so beautiful that the " +
    "sun itself, which has seen so much, was astonished whenever it shone in her face."
end

def run -> { width_32: array<string>, width_48: array<string> }
  text = sample_text
  {
    width_32: word_wrap(text, 32),
    width_48: word_wrap(text, 48)
  }
end

# vibe: 0.1.0

def head(values: array<int>) -> int?
  values.first
end

def tail(values: array<int>) -> int?
  values[1]
end

def build_matrix(x: int, y: int) -> array<array<int>>
  [[x, y], [y, x]]
end

def replace_first(values: array<int>, value: int) -> array<int>
  values[0] = value
  values
end

def update_without_aliasing(
  values: array<int>,
  value: int
) -> { updated: array<int>, original: array<int> }
  original = values
  values[0] = value
  { updated: values, original: original }
end

def run -> { head: int?, matrix: array<array<int>>, replaced: array<int>, tail: int? }
  {
    head: head([10, 20, 30]),
    tail: tail([10, 20, 30]),
    matrix: build_matrix(1, 2),
    replaced: replace_first([1, 2, 3], 99)
  }
end
